ex.en: There's a guy in my yoga class.
ex.zh: 我的瑜伽課上有個男生。

ex.en: Amy teaches yoga at a gym near the office.
ex.zh: Amy 在公司附近的健身房教瑜伽。

ex.en: My father retired to make way for younger people.
ex.zh: 我爸爸退休是為了讓位給年輕人。

ex.en: She is young but very experienced.
ex.zh: 她很年輕，但經驗很豐富。

ex.en: I have an older brother and a younger sister.
ex.zh: 我有一個哥哥和一個妹妹。

ex.en: Mary is the youngest of the three sisters.
ex.zh: 瑪麗是三姊妹中年紀最小的。

ex.en: My father must have been handsome in his youth.
ex.zh: 我爸爸年輕時一定很帥。

ex.en: In her youth, my mother was very beautiful.
ex.zh: 我媽媽年輕時非常漂亮。

ex.en: Whenever I hear that song, I remember my youth.
ex.zh: 每次聽到那首歌，我就想起自己的青春歲月。

ex.en: The youth of our land are not interested in politics.
ex.zh: 我們國家的年輕人對政治不感興趣。

ex.en: The city built a new youth center.
ex.zh: 市政府蓋了一座新的青年活動中心。
